description: This file declares the SetVolume class, which is a task for setting the volume in a media player context within the Rialto server project. It includes class definition, constructor, destructor, and execute method, along with private members for context, a wrapper, and volume value.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A class representing a task to set the volume in the media player context, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the player context, a Gst wrapper, and the desired volume.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set the volume in the media player context.
